prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: attached sprite sheet. Create a NEW transparent animation atlas for the SAME blonde woman, burgundy shirt, blue trousers, hiking boots, blue backpack, preserving exact character identity, smooth chibi illustration style, proportions, colors and clothes. Exactly 32 full-body sprites arranged in 8 equal columns and 4 equal rows, read left to right. No text, no grid, no backgrounds. Each cell same scale, feet baseline, body center, facing direction; generous transparent padding. This is an animation, each frame only subtle changes from preceding frame. Row 1 frames 0-7: friendly neutral and gradual blink, hands resting. Row 2 frames 8-15: suddenly concerned because pet escaped, raised worried eyebrows, small anxious mouth, one hand reaches inward; worried expressions clearly visible. Row 3 frames 16-23: worry gradually relaxes to relieved smile then closed-eye open-mouth laughter. Row 4 frames 24-31: seamless laughing loop, shoulders move VERY subtly, smiling closed eyes, open laughing mouth varying gently, hands relaxed. Lock torso and feet positions across ALL frames, no walking, no jumping, no big changes in pose, no pets. Truly transparent alpha background. Crisp smooth contours. Output wide landscape 2048x1024 sprite atlas.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: referenced Otto von Guericke portrait animation sheet. Produce a new transparent sprite atlas of EXACTLY 24 portraits in 8 equal columns and 3 equal rows, read left to right. Keep this SAME black-and-white historical portrait, hair, moustache, goatee, collar, silhouette and frontal direction. Each portrait must occupy exactly the same bounding rectangle and anchor, same size, same position, collar immovable. Animate ONLY eyelids, gaze and mouth: frames 0-7 slowly blink and smile; frames 8-15 wink and gradually stick out small pink tongue; frames 16-23 retract tongue and return to neutral. Smooth incremental changes, seamless first/last pose. No bobbing, no rotating, no silhouette shifts, no labels, no logo lettering, no grid. Transparent alpha. Wide landscape atlas 2048x1024.
